The federal government has suspended the $800-million life-extension program for the Royal Canadian Air Force's CH-146 Griffon helicopters due to technical issues and scope concerns.

The Bright Side:
Pausing now prevents the 'sunk cost' trap, allowing for a more realistic assessment of what can actually be salvaged from the aging fleet.
